basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast and budding firearms aficionado based in Austin, Texas. Recently got into guns and enjoy exploring local gun shows and discussing pricing trends. Works as a junior IT technician during the day and spends evenings gaming or tinkering with PC builds. In a committed relationship with a fellow gamer. Online mostly during evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possesses a solid understanding of computer hardware and software through a combination of self-teaching, online courses, and work experience. Recently started learning about firearms from online forums, videos, and attending local shows.
